messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT fired: prompt-eval-quality-regression (eval_gate v2) — PagerDuty PDR-91234 page fired for hosted-prod. Summary: drift_score spike, safety-fail rate up, eval-gate trips. Affected model variant: redwood/gptq-7b-quant-v2. Start: 2026-03-15T18:00:01Z.

Payload snippet:
```
{"alert":"prompt_eval_quality_regression","drift_score":0.62,"safety_fail_rate":0.35,"baseline_safety_fail":0.08,"window":"10m","affected_tenants":3}
```

Mike Torres: acked pager, I'm taking initial triage. Noting PagerDuty shows an active page. On it — steps: 1) quick impact estimate, 2) short mitigation (disable blocking), 3) deeper root-cause.

Jessica Kim: pulling telemetry now. Prom query -> `sum(rate(eval_gate_blocked[10m])) by (tenant)` shows blocked fraction jumped from ~8% to ~35% across traffic. Overall traffic unaffected, but blocked responses increased. 10m rolling: ~12% of total requests failing eval gate. Sending short grafana snapshots: <https://grafana.internal/r/redwood/eval-gate/xyz> :mag_right:

Anya Patel: thanks. Immediate mitigation proposal: switch eval-gate action from `block` to `warn` for prod, and route high-value tenants to fallback model `redwood/gpt-sm-2.1` for 30 minutes. That keeps users served while we investigate safety drift. Runbook: <https://internal/runbooks/eval-gate-mitigation>

Anya Patel: suggested command (internal ops tool):
```bash
rolloutsctl set-eval-gate --env=prod --action=warn --policy=global --note="temp soften after PDR-91234"
rolloutsctl set-routing --tenant org-234,org-77,org-980 --model=redwood/gpt-sm-2.1 --duration=30m
```

Mike Torres: running the rollout change now.
```
$ rolloutsctl set-eval-gate --env=prod --action=warn --policy=global --note="temp soften after PDR-91234"
> success: eval_gate policy updated (id: eg-2026-03-15-001)
$ rolloutsctl set-routing --tenant org-234,org-77,org-980 --model=redwood/gpt-sm-2.1 --duration=30m
> success: routing updated for 3 tenants
```

PagerDuty: PDR-91234 acknowledged by Mike Torres. If not resolved in 15m, escalation to eng-sre on-call will occur.

Lee O'Connor: quick customer-impact notes — org-234 (enterprise) saw ~60% of requests blocked for last 8m, org-77 ~52%, org-980 ~51%. Other tenants saw intermittent warnings only. CS alerted for org-234; their PM is pinged.

Nina Rao: CS update: I've messaged the org-234 TAM and product lead, they confirmed intermittent degraded outputs. We're offering the fallback and will monitor. CS will open a follow-up case and log for billing/regression impact. :phone:

Jessica Kim: after the `warn` change, safety-blocked metric dropped to ~4% in the 5m after. Drift_score backdown to 0.25. Still collecting full traces. forwarding log excerpt from inference-proxy:
```
2026-03-15T18:04:12Z [WARN] eval-gate: tenant=org-234 model=gptq-7b q=xyz safety_score=0.82 -> action=warn
2026-03-15T18:04:12Z [INFO] routed to redwood/gpt-sm-2.1 for tenant=org-234
```

Mike Torres: mitigation applied and provisional success. Next steps: 1) run sample evals on latest model weights vs baseline, 2) check recent model builds/quantization change logs pushed last 24h, 3) validate if any prompt changes in front-end templates could increase safety hits. Assigning investigation to @Sam Liu (oncall runtime).

Sam Liu: taking the handoff. I'll run batch eval with the latest evalset (safety-plus prompt set) and check model artifact hashes against last known-good. Also will re-run the A/B between gptq-7b-quant-v2 and gpt-sm-2.1 for the failing prompts. If we see clear model-quality regression, we'll roll model back.

Anya Patel: flags to check: recent quantization script updates, kernel change on serving nodes (nvfuser/attention kernels), any config flip on prefix caching that could alter prompt contexts. Check ML infra deploys around 2026-03-14T22:00Z.

Mike Torres: created incident ticket INC-2026-032 (triage: prompt-eval quality regression). Adding links and notes.

PagerDuty: note — escalation timer reset, next escalation in 15m if alert persists.

Sam Liu: plan for next 30m: run ~10k evals, collect diffs, check commit history for `model-artifacts/weights/redwood-gptq-7b/*` and `infra/quant` commits in last 24h. I'll post findings here. If I need help with rollback steps I will ping eng-runtime.

Mike Torres: handing off to Sam for investigation and longer-term RCA. I'll remain available for coordination and customer comms. Last update before handoff. :white_check_mark:

Sam Liu: acknowledged handoff — I'll update thread with findings and proposed RCA within 45 minutes.
